Verus now passes, and the bounded full test sweep is running.

The local progress proof checks executable term monotonicity, checked campaign increment, vote immutability, rejection of two distinct candidates at one node in a term, exact command append-prefix preservation, suffix truncation, freshness, membership construction, vote bitmap reset, stale-reply gating, majority role transition, recovery ballot checks and majority/current-term commit authorization; it does not establish any global target. The new quorum dependency proves overlap for arbitrary finite bitmaps and leader agreement conditional on both certificates referring to one vote ledger; relating that ledger to durable runtime history is unproved. A concrete one-member constructor/election call composition passes. The safety command passed foundation, definitions and progress; all implementation-dependent goals remained OPEN because implementation.rs is absent. Raft group identity is currently implicit in fixed peer endpoints; shard service gid is explicit durable state and is not yet represented in a proven observation history.
